mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 12-month MA for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST is below its 12-month MA for 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 12-month MA for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS is below its 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in the Industrial Production Index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in CPI above 3% signals inflationary pressure, which leads the Fed to raise interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPI exceeds 3% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
